Session completion summary

- Ticket: soldierly-whacky-merlin, canonical ID b126-b52c-f2bc-49bb, closed.
- Change: Gerrit 2221 merged on main as 8ad56d8ea3ed4d77b8a15434558ed4c877e30e11.
- Scope: Upgraded the code-review documentation overlay to agentic execution with read-only repository navigation, two-source evidence, bounded missing-update detection, documentation-role checks, generated-artifact ownership checks, and abstention when ownership or role is ambiguous.
- Guardrails: Preserved advisory and nonblocking posture, existing routing globs, nit suppression, and Pass 2 verification. Added no mechanical character, punctuation, vocabulary, diction, tone, wrapping, or subjective concision enforcement.
- Evaluation: Added repository-backed documentation cases for omissions, role violations, ambiguous ownership, protected evidence, unrelated documentation, and absent owners. Eval cases with files now use disposable fixture repositories. Inline cases retain their prior path.
- Verification: 198 focused tests passed. Repository lint and type checking passed. GitHub Actions run 32887076141 passed in 2519 seconds with no retries. Gerrit recorded Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1 with no unresolved comments.
- Completion: The completion verifier returned PASS with no findings and verified all 22 acceptance criteria against the merged revision. The verified acceptance boxes were marked complete, and the ticket closed.
- Concurrency: Another submission advanced main before this change. Gerrit rebased change 2221 during Submit, the origin mirror caught up, and no concurrency defect was confirmed.
- Worktree: The implementation worktree is clean at origin/main. The review branch remains preserved. Session logs remain open because their ticket type is lifecycle-exempt.
